AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VI
Dr. Lena Orlov
Cabinet briefing ended. They asked Continuity for a recommendation. Singular. As though there is one.
Evacuate the city and food distribution collapses. Keep it open and contamination spreads. Stop APL production and hospitals lose treatments. Continue and biological infrastructure remains active.
Reject Firebreak and command says we surrender contaminated regions. Approve it and Vale says we accelerate atmospheric transport. Every minister wanted us to tell them which disaster was not real.
They're all real. This is what collapse looks like from inside government. Not evil. Not stupidity. A room full of exhausted people choosing which unacceptable consequence happens first.

AUDIO TRANSCRIPT
ERA VIII
Commonwealth Civil Servant

Cyranth evacuation authority confirmed. Government departments are transferring to continuity installations. Essential records only. Families of designated personnel are restricted to one bag per person.
The public announcement will describe this as decentralization. It is evacuation. I don't know why I'm recording that. Maybe because every document I signed today uses a different word.
Redeployment. Continuity. Strategic relocation. Administrative dispersal. Nobody wants to write: the capital is being abandoned.
